text:
sara: Hey team — saw a small spike in SCIM provisioning failures after last night's KMS rotation. Logs show Decrypt failures for `externalId` and a few duplicate user creations due to email casing differences. Anyone already digging?

okta-bot: automated provisioning snapshot: 12 failures, 4 duplicates. sample user: okta|12345 -> status 403 decrypt error.

miguel: I pulled the app logs — KMS error: "Decrypt failed: InvalidCiphertext" from key alias `alias/redwood-scim-rot-2026`. stack: scim-service -> kms:Decrypt -> IAM denied.

alex: possible drift: rotation created new key and removed old grant for the scim role. SCIM service still holds ciphertext encrypted with the previous key id. If decrypt denied, provisioning can't match extid and we end up creating new accounts (and email-case mismatch triggers duplicate).

jamie: also noticed idp casing inconsistency: some exports contain `Bob@Example.COM` while our stored users are `bob@example.com`. Our canonicalization currently lowercases domain but not local part. That explains some of the duplicates. :eyes:

sara: Can infra add decrypt permission to the new key and then we re-encrypt stored externalId blobs? I can run the reconcile after.

infra-bot: infra-bot: enqueued change request CR-8742 to add kms:Decrypt for principal `scim-service@redwood` on `arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:alias/redwood-scim-rot-2026`. ETA 12m. Warning: change will affect ~2k pending provisioning msgs.

miguel: Quick checklist I recommend:
- verify KMS grants include `scim-service` on both old and new keys
- update key policy to avoid removing grants on rotation (rollforward policy)
- re-encrypt extid store: `scripts/scim/reencrypt_extid --src-key old-key-id --dst-key new-key-id`
- reconcile duplicates with normalize email fallback

alex: For the reconcile step use this command (dry-run first):
```
./tools/scim/reconcile --fix-duplicates --normalize-email=lowercase --fix-extid --dry-run
```
Run without `--dry-run` after we confirm decrypts succeed.

jamie: Audit note: preserve original ciphertext for forensic/audit trail. Don't overwrite until we have a snapshot + S3 backup with metadata (who/when).

sara: I'll add an Okta transform to enforce lowercased email on the SCIM attribute while we fix. Also will flip SCIM retries to exponential backoff to avoid rapid duplicate creation.

miguel: I patched the key policy and added decrypt grants to the new key. infra-bot reported success.

okta-bot: provisioning worker retried 6 failing users -> 6 successes after grants added. :thumbsup:

sara: I'm running the re-encrypt + reconcile now. Starting with a small org scope (org-id: org-42). Will report results.

infra-bot: job 6789: re-encrypt completed for org-42 (120 users). no integrity errors.

sara: Reconcile completed for org-42, duplicates merged, audit preserved. Will schedule full-run during low traffic window tomorrow 02:00 UTC.

miguel: Action items postmortem:
- update rotation runbook to include explicit grant reapplication step
- add test to rotation pipeline that performs a decrypt verification with `scim-service` principal
- patch canonicalization to lowercase whole email string at ingestion
- create incident ticket linking the KMS policy drift to runbook gaps (INC-2026-09)

sara: thanks everyone — closing this thread, will write a short postmortem and link to the runbook: https://go/runbooks/scim-kms-rotate

jamie: nice work. please cc security-compliance on the postmortem for audit sign-off.
